header.mode: Review, plus a plan for one new campaign

verdicts.change_window: no budget, target or bidding change in the 28-day change window; 2554 conversions in 30 days
verdicts.why: 30-day cost per install $1.63 is under the $1.80 target, and spend reached 90% of the budget on 26 of 30 days. Raise the budget once by 20% to $180; the ratio becomes 100.0x, still above 50x.

verdicts.change_window: target changed on 2026-10-06 (24 days ago); 767 conversions since
verdicts.why: Budget $120 is 34.3x the $3.50 target CPI; Google's guidance is at least 50x. Either raise the budget to $175 a day, or lower the target to $2.40, which is under the 30-day actual of $3.30 and would likely cut installs.

rows.why: The app is already released on Google Play.

subscribe has a median of 7.0 different users a day (one day hit 41, which is why the median is used) and 199 across the 28 days, short of 10 conversions a day or 300 in 30 days, and no target CPA campaign has run for this app yet.

guidance.rule: Target ROAS in App campaigns: at least 10 conversions every day (or 300 in 30 days), Firebase SDK value events, and a target CPA campaign run first

rows.why: Median 43.0 different Android users a day, at least 10; it is already a Google Ads conversion action; a $80 budget is 13.4x the $5.96 target CPA, at least 10x.

goal_choice_android.lands_on: Keep the installs campaign and add a separate in-app actions campaign on create_first_plan, paused, so the working installs campaign keeps its learning. Keep the installs campaign until the new one has 100 conversions.

target.label: derived
target.math: $1.80 target CPI / 0.302 (Android users creating a first plan per first open over 28 days in GA4: 1166 / 3860) = $5.96
target.caveat: GA4 counts organic and paid users together, so the share is an approximation for paid installers.
target.budget_check: $80 / $5.96 = 13.4x (needs at least 10x, so at least $59.60 a day)
